description: Whole sessions replayed by the rules engine (game-rules.md sections 4-7), shared by Apple and web. Each `session` is a complete, schema-valid session-v1 object. `expect` lists summary members (section 7) to compare exactly after the last action; members it does not list are not compared. `expect.error.at` is the index of the first rejected action, or -1 for a setup error (options, player count, player IDs). Expected values were worked out by hand from the rules text.
